decisions.sourceAudit: Source parses 550 exact individually numbered base card identities, player teams and 12 pack insert families from MyCardBatch. TCDB independently confirms 550 base, Gold Medallion 550, all 19 actual insert families (12 primary + seven printed Gold Medallion insert alternates) and 2 Ultra Extra promotional families; printed Bam Morris parent-set prototype audited.
decisions.series: Series One #1–350 and Ultra Extra Series Two #351–550; NEVER mix base cards across original separate series. Some original base checklists #350, #351, #352 are genuinely teamless non-player checklist subjects.
decisions.counts: 550 base + 550 Gold Medallion + 170 across 12 original pack insert groups + 80 across seven genuine Gold Medallion insert foil variations + 5 Ultra Extra promo sheet/individually separated cards + 1 Bam Morris parent-set prototype = 1,356, 24 product sets.
decisions.rookies: Source RC and EE suffixes removed from player name, retained as card subset/variant annotations. Derrick Alexander #184/#443 UER original birthdate noted, no fake corrective print-run cards.
decisions.goldVariants: Seven distinct insert Gold Medallion groups source verified: 1st Rounders, 2nd Year Standouts, Award Winners, Rising Stars, Touchdown Kings, Ultra Achievements, Ultra Stars. Use original insert template, NOT generic base Gold Medallion artwork.
decisions.promos: Ultra Extra pre-release perforated 4-card sheet (S1–S4) and individual 4 singles S1–S4 preserved as distinct genuine collector formats. TCDB lists separate printed #264 Bam Morris promo proof with Steelers/Pittsburgh statline discrepancy; no promo eligible for wax packs.
decisions.packs: Original Series One wax 12 cards x36 packs; 15-card premium/jumbo formats documented, while Ultra Extra changes Series/retail/hobby and pull eligibility. Product fields describe 12x36 Series One ONLY. Gold base parallel one per respective Series pack, but simple oddsPerPack cannot express deterministic 1 Gold slot, exclusive insert varieties and hot packs.
decisions.odds: Original TCDB group-level pull rates annotated for original Series and format, Gold insert parallels separately documented but specific original rates not verified. All ProductSet.oddsPerPack NULL intentionally to avoid fabricated single-pool rarity or accidental promotion of advanced promos, hot-packs and retailer-only inserts into wax.
decisions.release: Unreleased VCS draft pending authentic front/back scans, pack and box imagery, pricing, and series/format/guaranteed Gold/Hot Pack collation. Previous products and owned cards remain unchanged.
